parse.title: Enhanced Bow of the Quiddity
parse.text:
Introduced:  Gaining Ground Related Quests:  Quiddity Weapons, Weapon Upgrade Kit
Enhanced Bow of the Quiddity
Value: 20,000
550 Burden Units

Special Properties: Resistance Cleaving: Piercing

Skill: Missile Weapons (Bow)
Damage Bonus: 8 (28)
Damage Modifier: +130%
Speed: Slow (50) (0)
Range: 75 yds
Uses arrows as ammunition.
Bonus to Melee Defense: +14.0% (+27.0%)

Your base Missile Weapons must be at least 335 to wield this item.

Casts the following spells: Aura of Defender V, Aura of Blood Drinker VI, Aura of Swift Killer V, Aura of Heart Seeker V

Activation Requirements: Arcane Lore: 1, Bow: 200

Spellcraft: 400
Mana: 1000
Mana Cost: 1 point per 40 seconds.

Notes

  • Obtained by adding a Weapon Upgrade Kit to a Bow of the Quiddity.
